newsitem.title: NORWAY: Fokus Bank raises bid for BNbank.
newsitem.headline: Fokus Bank raises bid for BNbank.

text.p: Norway's fourth largest bank Fokus Bank said on Friday it had raised its bid for Bolig og Naeringsbanken (BNbank) to an exchange ratio of 3.4 Fokus shares for each share in BNbank.
On Tuesday Fokus announced it would offer 3.3 Fokus shares per BNbank share, with 20 percent of the consideration paid in cash.

"With today's share price for Fokus Bank the bid values each BNbank share at 211.10 crowns, with a total valuation of 2.059 billion crowns for the whole bank," Fokus said in a statement to the Oslo bourse.
Fokus shares were trading 0.50 crowns down at 58.50 on the Oslo bourse at 1439 GMT. It was trading four crowns ex-dividend on Friday.
Fokus raised its bid for BNbank after Norway's largest bank Den norske Bank ASA (DnB) made a counterbid for the niche mortgage lender.
DnB said it would offer a cash payment of 184.50 crowns per share, plus BNbank's 1996 dividend of 10.50 crowns.
"The total value of BNbank is thus stipulated at NOK 1,902 million," DnB said in a statement.
